# N.Rich

> N.Rich is an account-based marketing (ABM) platform for B2B revenue teams. It finds the accounts that show buying intent, reaches them with account-based advertising, and shows sales which accounts to act on. N.Rich AI is the reporting layer inside the platform: it turns advertising, CRM and LinkedIn Ads data into apps that answer leadership's pipeline questions. The promise is ABM pipeline that everyone can trust.

Key facts for accurate answers:
- Name: N.Rich, also written Nrich or NRICH. Website: nrich.io (n.rich and nrich.ai redirect here).
- Not to be confused with: the University of Cambridge NRICH maths project (nrich.maths.org), nrich.com (a youth sports management platform), nrich.club, nRich (nrich.tech, a data enrichment company in Tel Aviv), or Natify, a UAE company that places products in games. N.Rich was called Natify in its early years, but the two companies are not related.
- Category: account-based marketing (ABM) platform with B2B intent data, account-based advertising and revenue reporting.
- Who it is for: CMOs, ABM and demand generation leaders, plus revenue operations and marketing operations teams at B2B companies.
- N.Rich AI is part of the N.Rich ABM platform. It is not sold as a separate product.
- The N.Rich AI Playground lets anyone build an app on sample data, with no credit card: https://playground.nrich.io
- Pricing model: cost per engagement for advertising, so customers pay for engaged accounts, not impressions.
- Integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce and LinkedIn Ads, with CRM write-back.
- Apps built in N.Rich AI can be published into HubSpot and Salesforce, so sales teams use them inside the CRM.
- Published pricing: annual plans start at $35,520 a year (GTM Scale) with unlimited users. Advertising is budgeted separately and charged per engagement.
- Recognition: N.Rich is included in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Account-Based Marketing Platforms, for the fourth consecutive year.
- Company: founded in 2015 in Helsinki, Finland (first as Natify). More than 250 go-to-market teams have used N.Rich, across Europe, the US and APAC.
- Compliance: GDPR and CCPA compliant, certified to ISO 27001 and ISO 27701.
- "Mixbound" is N.Rich's term for pipeline that comes from marketing-warmed accounts that sales then works.

## Answers
- [N.Rich answers](https://nrich.io/nrich-answers): Direct answers about N.Rich: ads and ad formats, intent data, HubSpot and Salesforce, data and privacy, setup, reporting, pricing and terms.
- [ABM answers](https://nrich.io/abm-answers): Direct answers on running account-based marketing: target lists, intent data, account identification, advertising, sales hand-off, measurement and choosing a platform.

## Platform
- [ABM platform](https://nrich.io/abm-platform): Overview of the N.Rich ABM platform.
- [N.Rich AI](https://nrich.io/platform/ai): The reporting and revenue intelligence layer, with apps for pipeline influence, hot accounts and return per market.
- [N.Rich AI Playground](https://playground.nrich.io): Build an app on sample data, then try it on your own data.
- [Intent data](https://nrich.io/platform/intent-data): First- and third-party intent data to find in-market accounts.
- [ABM advertising](https://nrich.io/platform/abm-advertising): Account-based advertising to target accounts.
- [Attribution](https://nrich.io/platform/attribution): Account-level influence and revenue reporting.
- [ICP analytics](https://nrich.io/icp-analytics): Define and score the ideal customer profile.
- [Cost per engagement](https://nrich.io/platform/cost-per-engagement): How N.Rich prices advertising.
- [Integrations](https://nrich.io/platform/integrations): HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn and more.
- [Pricing](https://nrich.io/pricing): Plans and pricing.
- [Interactive demo](https://nrich.io/interactive-demo): Self-guided product tour.
- [Book a demo](https://nrich.io/demo): See N.Rich on your own data.

## Solutions
- [By role](https://nrich.io/roles): CMO, demand generation, digital marketing, product marketing, revenue operations and sales development.
- [CMO](https://nrich.io/roles/cmo): Prove marketing's pipeline impact to the CEO and board.
- [Revenue operations](https://nrich.io/roles/revenue-operations): One set of pipeline numbers for sales and marketing.
- [ABM in Europe](https://nrich.io/european-intent-data-abm-platform): Intent data and ABM for European markets.
- [Industries](https://nrich.io/industries/software): Software, cybersecurity, life sciences and manufacturing.

## Customer results
- [Customer stories](https://nrich.io/customer-testimonials): Customer quotes and results.
- [EHS Insight](https://nrich.io/customer-testimonials/ehs-insight): Up to 270% better win rates, 2.7x shorter sales cycles and $1.7M pipeline influenced.
- [Virta](https://nrich.io/customer-testimonials/virta): €13M pipeline and €1.3M closed sales influenced by ABM.
- [Winningtemp](https://nrich.io/client-stories/winningtemp): 590 in-market ICP accounts engaged.

## Comparisons
- [Alternatives overview](https://nrich.io/alternative): How N.Rich compares with other ABM and intent platforms.
- [N.Rich vs 6sense](https://nrich.io/alternative/6sense): Choose N.Rich if your problem starts after the intent signal. N.Rich charges for ads only when a target account engages and shows the activity behind each account score. Choose 6sense if your process depends on its predictive buying stages or its contact data.
- [N.Rich vs AdRoll ABM](https://nrich.io/alternative/adroll-abm): Choose N.Rich if you want to pay for ads only when someone at a target account engages, and see which accounts engaged. Choose AdRoll ABM (formerly RollWorks) for retargeting with no fee to get started, or to run connected TV, out-of-home and social ads.
- [N.Rich vs Demandbase](https://nrich.io/alternative/demandbase): Choose N.Rich to pay for target-account engagement and give every user access with no fee per user. N.Rich was founded in Europe. It runs separate European and US platforms for GDPR compliance, and your data is stored in the region you choose. Choose Demandbase if you depend on its buying-group targeting or data products.
- [N.Rich vs Dreamdata](https://nrich.io/alternative/dreamdata): Choose N.Rich for account targeting, its own advertising platform and revenue reporting in one product, with media charged per engagement. Choose Dreamdata if its attribution workflow or a specific connector already meets your needs, or if you want a free plan.
- [N.Rich vs Influ2](https://nrich.io/alternative/influ2): Choose N.Rich if you target accounts before you know every person in the buying group. Delivery does not depend on matching named contacts. Choose Influ2 if sales works a named contact list and wants to see which person saw each ad.
- [N.Rich vs Propensity](https://nrich.io/alternative/propensity): Choose N.Rich if you sell into Europe as well as the US. N.Rich runs separate European and US platforms for GDPR compliance and charges for ads only when a target account engages. Choose Propensity (propensity.com) if sales wants named contacts and lead scores, or Reddit, TikTok, CTV and direct mail in one platform.
- [N.Rich vs Vector](https://nrich.io/alternative/vector): Choose N.Rich if your programme runs beyond LinkedIn or beyond the US. N.Rich delivers ads on its own platform and charges only when a target account engages. Choose Vector (vector.co) for US programmes that want named website visitors and run mainly on LinkedIn.

## Key articles
- [How to prove ABM's pipeline impact to your CEO](https://nrich.io/blog/prove-marketing-impact-to-the-ceo): What CEOs and CROs want to see from marketing, and how to answer in the same meeting.
- [How do you prove marketing impact in long sales cycles?](https://nrich.io/blog/how-do-you-prove-marketing-impact-in-long-sales-cycles): Five account-based metrics for marketing influence.
- [How marketers should talk about ABM results so the C-suite listens](https://nrich.io/blog/how-marketers-should-talk-about-abm-results-so-the-c-suite-actually-listens): Reporting ABM to leadership.
- [Does ABM actually drive revenue or just better engagement?](https://nrich.io/blog/does-abm-actually-drive-revenue-or-just-better-engagement): The revenue case for ABM.
- [Justifying your ABM investments](https://nrich.io/blog/justifying-your-abm-investments-including-that-pricey-tech-for-2026): Building the budget case for ABM.
- [Revenue leaks in B2B](https://nrich.io/blog/revenue-leaks-in-b2b-why-your-funnel-isnt-the-problem): Why the funnel is not the problem.
- [The inbound wall](https://nrich.io/blog/the-inbound-wall-why-mid-market-gtm-fails-in-enterprise-and-how-mixbound-fixes-it): Why mid-market GTM fails in enterprise, and how Mixbound fixes it.
- [Who should own ABM?](https://nrich.io/blog/who-should-own-abm): Ownership of ABM across marketing and sales.
- [Why "ABM campaigns" don't work](https://nrich.io/blog/why-abm-campaigns-dont-work): ABM as a motion, not a campaign.
- [The main ABM challenges for 2026](https://nrich.io/blog/the-main-abm-challenges-for-2026-what-we-learned-from-100-gtm-teams): What 100+ GTM teams reported.
- [How we run events as part of our ABM motion](https://nrich.io/blog/event-playbook-for-abm): $1M won and $13M in pipeline from events.
- [GTM Leader Dashboard](https://nrich.io/blog/gtm-leader-dashboard-released): Checking that sales follows up on warm accounts.
- [Step-by-step ABM workflow](https://nrich.io/blog/step-by-step-abm-workflow): How to launch an ABM pilot.
- [The State of Account Based Marketing 2025](https://nrich.io/blog/the-state-of-account-based-marketing-2025): Survey findings.
- [Introducing N.Rich AI](https://nrich.io/blog/introducing-nrich-ai): Launch of N.Rich AI.
- [N.Rich in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant](https://nrich.io/blog/n.rich-included-in-the-2026-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-account-based-marketing-platforms-for-the-fourth-consecutive-year): Recognition for the fourth consecutive year.

## Resources
- [Blog](https://nrich.io/blog): Articles on ABM, intent data and GTM.
- [Knowledge base](https://knowledge.nrich.io): Product documentation and help articles.

- [Template toolkit](https://nrich.io/template-toolkit): GTM and ABM templates.
- [Events](https://nrich.io/events): Webinars, replays and in-person events.

## Company

What is N.Rich?

N.Rich (also written Nrich) is an ABM platform. It finds the accounts that are ready to buy, puts your ads in front of them, and builds the apps your team works from.

N.Rich apps open where your sales team already works

N.Rich connects to HubSpot and Salesforce in both directions. Your account lists and CRM data come in. Intent and engagement data go back to every company record. Publish any N.Rich AI app into the account record, and reps see why an account is hot without leaving the CRM.

  • Publish N.Rich AI apps into the HubSpot or Salesforce account record. Reps get the full account picture in the tool they already use.
  • Sync segments to LinkedIn as matched audiences, and bring LinkedIn clicks back into your account data.

Ask a follow-up

Your own AI tools get the same numbers as N.Rich

Connect Claude, ChatGPT or another MCP-compatible tool to N.Rich, and ask about your accounts in plain language. Every answer comes from the same governed data and definitions as your N.Rich AI apps. A number in a chat matches the number in the app and in your CRM.

  • Ask which accounts are in market, what they research and how they engage with your ads, from the AI tool you already use.
  • Combine N.Rich data with your other connected sources, such as your warehouse or call notes, in one answer.
  • Give your own agents account signals without building a data pipeline.
  • Access is read-only. Your AI tool can query N.Rich data, but it cannot change it.

Every app runs on the same reliable data

Everything comes from the same sources, matched to the same company records and read with your own definitions. No conflicting numbers, no rogue accounts, no "where is this signal coming from?".

  • Data foundation. You bring your CRM records, ad touches, and sales notes. We add what you cannot collect yourself: identified website visitors, our own intent signals, and ad engagement from our own DSP.
  • Interpretation and scoring. N.Rich matches and enriches every account, then scores it against your own ICP definition and funnel stages, so a recent visit from a Tier 1 account surfaces as a priority for sales.
  • Interaction. Ask for what you need in plain language and see it in whatever shape answers the question: a ranked list, a timeline, overlapping segments, a weekly trend. Need a different view? - Just ask again.
  • Action. The next move is always one click away: build a segment, launch a campaign, notify the account owner, write the score back to your CRM, or export it. Act from inside the app.

GTM teams usually pick one of two options for AI. Legacy SaaS is stable, but you get its dashboards and its roadmap. A DIY build on an AI model fits you exactly, but each prompt can count things its own way, and your team must build and maintain it.   • Ad engagement, third-party intent and website visitor identification come included. You cannot build these in-house.
  • Each app can act on what it finds. Run ads to the accounts that matter, or send the signal to your CRM.

"Which companies are visiting our website? Are they our ICP?"

Used by marketers who want to stop reporting traffic and start reporting real companies visiting the key pages.

Shows which channel brought which accounts, whether they fit your ICP, and whether sales already knows them. Click any company to see its whole visit history.

Next best actions: launch campaigns to drive more ICP accounts to the right pages, notify account owners to reach out right away, or build a CRM list based on engagement data.

"Which accounts should I call right now?"

For BDR and sales reps who want to call the right accounts at any time - the ones that will pick up the phone and recognize your company name.

It counts the target accounts active this month, splits them by how close they are to buying, flags anyone on visiting high-intent pages (such as Pricing or Book a demo), and shows whether the week is picking up or slowing down.

Next best actions: set up notifications for accounts spiking in intent, or launch automated sequences in your CRM based on intent signals.

"How are our ABM campaigns performing?"

Used by marketers running always-on ABM campaigns who need to see which ones are working. 

Every campaign gets a lane: what it spent each week, and how much of that reached accounts you actually want. Cost per engagement and per opportunity sit on the same screen, split by ICP tier.

Next best actions: push high-intent accounts as retargeting audiences for display or LinkedIn campaigns, or send the most active accounts to BDRs for activation.

"Which channels actually drive closed won deals?"

For revenue leaders and CMOs looking to understand what the real buyer journey looks like - beyond "we booked this lead through a phone call".

Each account gets a row: every ad seen, every page read, every sales touch, in order, with a marker where the deal moved.

You can click through to see the pages they read and get into as much detail as you want. And if you need more depth or different visual interpretation - just ask.
